existing_rows_audit.detail: The Amsterdam office and the C++ technology track are both real and hiring (19 open Amsterdam technology reqs on 4 Aug 2026), but no req is titled 'C++ Engineer'. The equivalent live seats are 'Software Engineer - Automated Trading Systems' (https://optiver.com/join-us/jobs/technology/amsterdam/software-engineer-automated-trading-systems/, 4+ yrs, C++ on Linux) and 'Quantitative Developer - Pricing Data'. Two further corrections to that row: (a) the eligibility note '0-3 YoE experienced tech reqs' is not supported - the Amsterdam C++ req states 4+ years, though it adds 'We are looking for both senior and junior brilliant minds'; (b) the '~300 interns/yr' and '€90-140k' figures appear nowhere on Optiver's site and no comp figure is stated on any Optiver posting, so the comp column is unverified.

Out of scope for this pass (US), but for the record: the Chicago office is real (listed on https://optiver.com/join-us/locations/) and has 15 open technology reqs, none titled 'C++ Engineer' - the nearest are 'Software Engineer - Trading Strategies' and 'Senior Production Software Engineer' (https://optiver.com/en/api/v1/jobs?location=chicago&department=technology). The $300-420k comp figure is not stated on any Optiver page I loaded.

Out of scope for this pass (US), but for the record: the Austin office is real (listed on https://optiver.com/join-us/locations/) with 10 open technology reqs; the closest live title is 'Senior Software Engineer C++', not 'C++ Engineer' (https://optiver.com/en/api/v1/jobs?location=austin&department=technology). The $300-400k comp figure is not stated on any Optiver page I loaded.

notes:
Method: optiver.com/working-at-optiver/career-opportunities/ is a JS-rendered listing that server-renders only the first 16 of 180 reqs. I found its backing endpoint (https://optiver.com/en/api/v1/jobs) and its pagination parameters (from/size, discovered in the site's SortFilterList JS chunk) and enumerated every req in every in-scope city, then loaded each individual posting page directly. Totals as of 4 Aug 2026: Amsterdam 33, Shanghai 27, Singapore 7, London 6, Hong Kong 1. Every role above was read on its own posting page.

Offices: optiver.com/join-us/locations/ lists exactly 11 offices - Amsterdam, Austin, Chicago, Hong Kong, London, Mumbai, New York, Shanghai, Singapore, Sydney, Taipei. There is NO Tokyo office and no EU office other than Amsterdam (no Paris, Dublin, Frankfurt, Zurich, Milan or Warsaw). Taipei and Mumbai are out of the brief's scope. The jobs filter also exposes Miami and Philadelphia as locations, which do not appear on the locations page; both are US and out of scope, so I did not chase the discrepancy.

Hong Kong: the office exists but has exactly one open req firm-wide, 'Head of Business Development (D1 Cash)' (Strategy), which is out of track. So Hong Kong contributes zero roles despite being a confirmed office.

London is thin: 6 open reqs total, of which only 'Software Engineer - Reference Data' and 'Institutional Trader' are in track. There is also a 'Cloud Infrastructure Engineer - Digital Assets' in London which I excluded - it is a Terraform/AWS platform-SRE role requiring Python or Go, with no C++ and no ML content.

Similarly excluded as out of track despite being technology reqs: Amsterdam Systems Engineer / Linux Systems Engineer / Linux Engineer - Bare Metal & Kubernetes / Site Reliability Engineer / Production Engineer / Network Engineer - Low Latency / Data Center Engineer(ing Lead) / Senior + Principal Data Engineer / Trading Operations Engineer / Technical Program Manager; Shanghai Production Operations Engineer, Network Operations Engineer, Data Center Engineer, Procurement Sourcing Specialist, Telecom Project Manager, Head of AI Engineering (leadership); Singapore Data Center Engineer; and all 'Cash Equity German Institutional Sales' / 'Trading Operations Analyst' reqs (sales and ops, not trading).

Two reqs appear in the API for Singapore - 'Career Kickstarter Singapore - Technology' and 'Career Kickstarter Singapore - Trading and Research' - whose posting pages both return HTTP 404. I could not read them so I did not create rows; both are early-careers programs and would be student-gated in any case.

Compensation: Optiver states no salary figures on any posting I loaded, in any of the 5 in-scope cities. Every comp_local field is therefore empty, and the figures in the three existing spreadsheet rows should be treated as unsourced.

Mandarin: none of the Shanghai postings state a Mandarin requirement; all are written in English with only the privacy disclaimer in Chinese. The 'Options Quantitative Researcher' req goes further and states 'English speaking is a must'. That said, mainland China seats still need sponsorship and day-to-day working language is not something the postings confirm.

Student gates found (per the brief's instruction to flag them): Career Kickstarter - Tech (graduation May 2025 - Aug 2027, must start full-time by Sept 2027), Career Kickstarter - Trading 2026 (BSc/MSc graduating Sept 2024 - Sept 2027), and 2026 Shanghai PhD QuantFocus (PhD students only, deadline 27 July 2026 already passed). A Feb-2026 MSc technically falls inside the first two windows, but both funnel to graduate-level offers and would be a level reset.
